description: TY2027 premium tax credit (Rev. Proc. 2026-26 § 3.01; 2026 poverty guidelines $15,960, 91 FR 1797). Single, household income $40,000 = 250.62% FPL → 8.66% + 1.56% × 0.62/50 = 8.68% (percent-cents, half-up) → contribution $3,472; credit $7,000 − $3,472 = $3,528; advance $5,000 → repay $1,472 in full. Tax: taxable income $23,400, Tax Table midpoint $23,425 → $1,280 + 12% × $10,625 = $2,555. Net tax $2,555 + $1,472 = $4,027.
